edits.before: - Yasuo Wind Wall: matchup-defining — Blocks every projectile for its duration — hold your poke until it is spent. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Nevermove like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Yasuo Wind Wall: 25s at rank 1, 17s max, blocks projectiles for 4s — once it drops you get 20+ seconds of a wall-less Yasuo. - His R Last Breath is 70s at rank 1 and needs a knockup — deny the tornado and it never fires.

edits.before: Q-poke through the wave — the hand hurts more than people remember. Farm safely; your real spells arrive next.
edits.after: Yasuo is near-melee at level 1 — your 750-range Q cone out-trades him before Wind Wall or tornado stacks exist.

edits.before: Liandry's spike: the drain outpaces their damage in any extended fight. Force rivers, root the entry, ascend, profit.
edits.after: His first crit item flips the duel — the DPS jumps and a 25-second Wind Wall walls your Q and E. Fight only with help.

edits.before: Late Swain is the anti-team: flank-root their engage, ascend in their backline, and demonflare the clump that forms around you.
edits.after: Itemized Yasuo out-DPSes the drain and walls your spells on demand — flank-root his engage and let your team bait Wind Wall first.

edits.before: E his step-up, passive-pull the root for the chunk + heal, Q the retreat — every landed root is a won trade with a health refund attached.
edits.after: Demonic Ascension drains minions as well as champions — brawling inside your wave adds free healing targets while he burns E dashes to reach you.

edits.before: Brawling pre-6 like the demon is already online — Swain without R is a slow mage with a dream and a root on cooldown.
edits.after: His passive shield rebuilds as he moves and eats your opening hit — an auto war just feeds Flow; strip the shield with Q first.
